filters.label: 💨 SMOKE:
filters.tip: Kill through a smoke grenade (DB column — fast, no demoparser2 needed).

filters.label: 🔭 NO-SCOPE:
filters.tip: No-scope kill — sniper only (DB column).

filters.label: ⚡ VICTIM FLASHED:
filters.tip: Victim was blinded by a flashbang (DB column).

filters.label: 🧱 WALLBANG:
filters.tip:
Kill where the bullet penetrated at least one obstacle.
Uses kills.penetrated_objects > 0  or  kills.has_penetrated / kills.penetrated.
Falls back to demoparser2 if no matching column is found in the DB.

filters.label: 😵 BLIND FIRE:
filters.tip:
Bullet fired while the killer was blinded by a flashbang.
Uses kills.attacker_blinded / kills.is_attacker_blinded / kills.attacker_blind.
Falls back to demoparser2 if no matching column is found in the DB.

filters.label: 🪂 AIRBORNE:
filters.tip:
Bullet fired while the killer was in the air (not on ground).
Uses player_death.attackerinair — demoparser2 required, not stored in CSDM DB.

filters.label: 🎯 COLLATERAL:
filters.tip:
Single bullet penetrated and killed multiple players in the same shot chain.
Uses player_death.penetrated + shot grouping via demoparser2.

filters.label: 🎲 TROIS SHOT:
filters.tip:
Lucky kills on precision weapons — detected via demoparser2.

Per-weapon logic:
  Deagle / R8   bloom > 0.015 (not a stationary aimed shot)
  AWP / SSG 08  unscoped at shot time
  SCAR-20 / G3SG1  unscoped OR bloom > 0.010 OR moving

Enable = keep only lucky kills. Exclude = keep only precise kills on these weapons.
⚠ Enable and Exclude are mutually exclusive.

filters.label: 🎯🎲 TROIS TAP:
filters.tip:
TROIS SHOT + ONE TAP: lucky isolated headshot.
Must be a headshot, qualify as lucky, and have no other shot within 2s.
HS is auto-forced only when active logic guarantees HS-only output.

filters.label: 🎯 ONE TAP:
filters.tip:
Isolated single-shot headshot — no other shot within N seconds before or after.
HS is auto-forced only when active logic guarantees HS-only output.

filters.label: 🔫 SPRAY TRANSFER:
filters.tip:
≥2 enemies killed in one continuous spray (no trigger release).
Auto weapons only: AK-47, M4A4/M4A1-S, Galil AR, FAMAS, SG 553, AUG, SMGs, M249, Negev, CZ75.

filters.label: 🏎 FERRARI PEEK:
filters.tip:
Moving peek that kills on a single shot then immediately resumes.
Approach speed ≥ threshold, one shot, resumes movement within 2s.
CS2 run speeds: knife 250 · pistols 240 · AK-47 215 · AWP 200 u/s

filters.label: ↩ FLICK:
filters.tip:
Kill preceded by a large view-angle change (~0.5s before kill tick).
Default: 50°. Lower = catch smaller corrections, raise = extreme flicks only.

filters.label: 🛡 SAVIOR:
filters.tip:
Kill an enemy who was actively damaging a teammate in the ~2s prior.
Captures last-second rescues.

filters.label: 🚀 ENTRY FRAG:
filters.tip: First kill of the round (earliest tick), regardless of side.

filters.label: 🃏 ACE:
filters.tip: Rounds where the player eliminated all 5 opponents alone.

filters.label: ⚡ MULTI-KILL:
filters.tip: N or more kills in one round within the time window.

filters.label: 💀 BULLY:
filters.tip:
Kill the same opponent for the Nth time in the match.
e.g. From kill #3 = captured from the 3rd time you kill the same player.

filters.label: 💰 ECO FRAG:
filters.tip:
Pistol kill against a full-buy opponent (rifle / sniper / LMG).
Falls back to all pistol kills if victim_weapon column is missing.

filters.label: 👥 MATE POV:
filters.tip:
Record from the victim's teammate who has the best angular view of the kill.
Uses demoparser2 player positions + view angles at kill tick.
Filters: victim eye clearly in view (±20°), alive mate, same floor (Z ≤300 u),
elevation ≤30°, distance 80–550 u. No BSP ray-cast — walls not detected.
★ Must = skip clips with no qualifying teammate.
